music_client.desc: Configure online music sources. Too many sources may slow down search performance.
music_client.client_limit_desc: Limit the number of songs requested per client. Too high a value may significantly reduce search speed.

online_search.each_song_ave_timeout_desc: Average time limit (in seconds) allocated to search each song.

accessibility.audioFocusPauseDesc: Automatically pause playback when another app starts playing sound.
